### 2026-10-18 – Realised my basket totalled an average around £1000 so started to adjust all of my parts combining some deleting the most expensive and so on. Part 16 cost around £50-£150 almost always and it was a s

**0.8h**

Realised my basket totalled an average around £1000 so started to adjust all of my parts combining some deleting the most expensive and so on. Part 16 cost around £50-£150 almost always and it was a supporting block so the tracks would collapse so I spend ages adjusting removing and resisizng it in hope that it would eventually work. At one point I found a vendor that would do it for 114£ and I was like hang on. Then I saw that part 16 was £64 so I spent another like 10 ish mins there trying to fix it.

Also, my mouse died so I had to use a touchpad which was a nightmare. And because I originally built the entire thing upside down I kept having to rotate the view screen.
